name: Cabezas de Alambre (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally light blue over yellow within a white border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cabezas de Alambre (blue and yellow with a bordure of Moors' heads).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 14 November 1994 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 16 of 24 January 1995); the flag is square, divided horizontally, sky blue above and yellow below, edged in white and charged at the centre with the municipal arms.

features.role: Cabezas de Alambre arms — blue and yellow with Moors' heads
